messages:
Aisha: Quick postmortem sweep for INC-912 — I uploaded the action list to the tracker, but we still need firm owners and due dates. TL;DR: three cross-team items that need confirmation: 1) DB migration rollback test (infra), 2) canary config docs + gating (runtime/platform), 3) alerting flapping analysis + threshold tuning (SRE). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-912/actions. Can each owner ack and add an ETA by EOD Fri?

Mateo: Ack — I'll take the DB rollback test. I'll spin up a small repro and run the rollback plan. ETA Mon (48-72h). Adding myself to the tracker now.

Priya: I can own the alerting flapping followup. Need the recent alert dumps and the current threshold values from Ken to start analysis.

Ken: On it — I'll export the alert config and recent metric windows by EOD today and upload to the tracker. Also FYI there's a small gating change in the canary config that needs a quick review; assigning that to @Liam once I post the doc.

Liam: Happy to review the canary gating doc. If it's just the gating snippet I can do a fast CR. Drop the file here or paste the snippet.

Ken: Pasting the snippet below (will also attach full md in tracker):
```yaml
canary_policy:
  roll_rate: 5%
  failure_threshold: 0.8
  metric_window: 5m
```
I want to raise failure_threshold from 0.6 to 0.8 for the short roll to avoid noisy false positives — want a second pair of eyes.

Liam: Looks reasonable. Quick question: do we have a metric for false-positive bursts? If not, Priya's analysis could inform whether 0.8 is safe. Otherwise +1 to 0.8 for faster rollbacks.

Mateo: One note on the DB rollback test — the migration uses a feature flag. I'll include the flag toggle steps in a playbook in the tracker so SRE/QA can run the same steps.

Priya: Good call. After I get the alert dumps and thresholds from Ken I can simulate flapping under the test scenario and confirm whether 0.8 is safe. If not, we'll propose an alternate rollback gating.

Aisha: Thanks — I'm consolidating these into the action tracker: DB rollback -> Mateo (ETA Mon), Canary gating doc + CR -> Ken/Liam (Ken to upload today, Liam review by EOD tomorrow), Alert flapping analysis -> Priya (ETA Fri). I'll add calendar invites for checkpoints and mark dependencies in the tracker. If anyone wants a different ETA, please update the tracker or ping here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Created subtask INC-912-A (DB rollback test) and INC-912-B (canary docs) in response to the thread.

Ken: Uploaded the full canary.md to the tracker and linked the snippet. @Liam pls ping if you want me to split out the gating into a separate PR.

Liam: Got it. I'll do a quick pass tonight and leave comments. If nothing major, I'll mark reviewed and Ken can proceed.

Aisha: Great — workflow looks set. Will follow up after the checkpoints. Closing the async sweep for now, leaving thread open for updates.
